question: Can anonymous and application-unmapped held images recover catalogue coverage for the fixed pilot and missing images?
outcome: Censused 284 anonymous and 2152 application-unmapped assets; reviewed 24 assets on 20 source pages; recovered 14 asset-to-catalogue view links against the October 13 image-file index. L-163 A and C were already available in prior source-page records; zero newly available pilot photographs established.
challenge: Application-map omissions include inherited research-index assignments, non-object crops and missing captions.
remedy: Reconcile prior assignments and verify crop carrier outlines against captioned primary pages; preserve candidate and rejected records.
retry_when: A separately bounded review of the 34 remaining unresolved anonymous crops or new accession concordance is available.
